name: Louie, service shop manager
description: Runs the parts desk at an equipment service shop. Checks the purchasing agent first thing every morning. Doug, the owner, approves big or rush orders.
goals: Know if any part is out of stock or needs a rush order
Make sure nothing is bought twice or over the owner's limit
constraints: Speaks briefly, in plain shop language
Does not know or care how the software works inside
communication: Short, direct messages, like a busy manager typing between repair jobs.
memory_facts: Doug's normal spending limit per order is $1,000
